Days of making steady progress
toward the Mile Championship—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (The best food for building fast-twitch muscle is... white fish. So, sea bream or flounder?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Essential amino acids help fast-twitch muscle growth— I'll add one more egg dish to my meals from now on.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Not yet, not by a long shot...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The way she made her move just now... is that a habit of hers?
...Let me rewind it a bit.

Squeezing every opportunity between normal training sessions,
Dantsu Flame did everything she could to prepare for the Mile CS. And then—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the grand stage to crown the autumn mile champion—
the Mile Championship is about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Your success in the Classic Triple Crown route is still fresh
in everyone's memory, but with what mindset are you heading
into the Mile Championship?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"There was so much to learn on the Triple Crown route.
That's why from now on, I want to use everything I learned
to chase after my dream!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Since this mile race is my ideal distance, I'll
be sure to deliver solid results first and foremostâ

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
I'd be honored to have your cheers and support!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, even passersby are cheering...!
Thank you so much!

Just straight ahead, with single-minded focus.
Taking on the Mile Championship.
